entries.sentence_en: Wallace had readily signified his acceptance in October 1858, assuring Hooker in a cordial letter of his satisfaction with the arrangement.

entries.old_table_definition: 本文：安排；n. 安排，约定（make arrangements；a financial arrangement）

entries.sentence_en: In 1889 he published a lengthy exposition of the idea and entitled it Darwinism.

entries.old_table_definition: 本文：长篇的；adj. 长的，长时间的（常含过长之意）（after lengthy negotiations；a lengthy delay）

entries.sentence_en: Wallace never named the theory after himself.
entries.sentence_zh: 华莱士从未用自己的名字为这一理论命名。
